import json
	
	successful = value["successful"]
	totalEvents = value["totalEvents"]
	actionsFrequency = value["actionsFrequency"]
	
	totalEventsNum = totalEvents.rowCount
	
	headers = ["displaypath", "cnt", "percentage"]
	
	rows = []
	
	# Filas fijas arriba - todo como string para evitar conflicto de tipos
	rows.append(["Successfull Action", str(successful), ""])
	rows.append(["Total Events", str(totalEventsNum), ""])
	
	# Filas de acciones - cnt y percentage también como string
	for item in actionsFrequency:
	    if isinstance(item, str):
	        item = json.loads(item)
	    
	    cnt = int(item["cnt"])
	    displaypath = item["displaypath"]
	    percentage = round((float(cnt) / float(totalEventsNum) * 100), 2) if totalEventsNum else 0
	    
	    rows.append([displaypath, str(cnt), str(percentage)])
	
	return system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, rows)

"""
	Transform date value based on user-selected period and shift options.
	
	Args:
		value (Date): Date value to transform
		quality (Quality): Data quality (not used)
		timestamp (Timestamp): Value timestamp (not used)
	
	Returns:
		Date: Transformed date based on selected options
	
	Example:
		# User selects "Shift A" with "Day" shift
		# Input: 2026-02-03 14:30:00
		# Output: 2026-02-03 05:59:59
	"""
	
	def setDateTime(year, month, day, hour, minute=0, second=0):
		"""
		Set date and time to specific values.
		
		Args:
			year (int): Year
			month (int): Month
			day (int): Day
			hour (int): Hour
			minute (int, optional): Minute. Defaults to 0.
			second (int, optional): Second. Defaults to 0.
		
		Returns:
			Date: Date with specified time
		"""
		date = system.date.getDate(year, month, day)
		return system.date.setTime(date, hour, minute, second)
	
	# Extract date components
	year = system.date.getYear(value)
	month = system.date.getMonth(value)
	day = system.date.getDayOfMonth(value)
	hour = system.date.getHour24(value)
	minute = system.date.getMinute(value)
	
	# Get user selections
	endTime = self.getChild("root").getChild("Filters").getChild("FilterContainer").getChild("FilterEndDate").getChild("DateTimeInputEndDate").props.value
	shift = self.custom.times.shift
	dropDownPeriod = self.getChild("root").getChild("Filters").getChild("FilterContainer").getChild("FilterPeriod").getChild("DropdownPeriod").props.value
	
	# Process selected period
	if dropDownPeriod == 7:  # Custom selected
		value = endTime
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Shift A
		if shift == 'Day':
			value = setDateTime(year, month, day, 5, 59, 59)
		elif shift == 'Night':
			if hour < 18:  # In Shift C between 0:00 and 5:59
				value = setDateTime(year, month, day - 1, 17, 59, 59)
			else:
				value = setDateTime(year, month, day, 17, 59, 59)
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Shift B
		value = setDateTime(year, month, day, hour, minute, 0)
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 3:  # Previous Day
		value = setDateTime(year, month, day - 1, 23, 59, 59)
	
	else:  # Default case - current hour and minute
		value = setDateTime(year, month, day, hour, minute, 0)
	
	return value

"""
	Transform date value based on user-selected period and shift options.
	
	Args:
		value (Date): Date value to transform
		quality (Quality): Data quality (not used)
		timestamp (Timestamp): Value timestamp (not used)
	
	Returns:
		Date: Transformed date based on selected options
	
	Example:
		# User selects "Current Day" with "Day" shift
		# Input: 2026-02-03 14:30:00
		# Output: 2026-02-03 00:00:00
	"""
	
	def setDateTime(year, month, day, hour):
		"""
		Set date and time to specific values.
		
		Args:
			year (int): Year
			month (int): Month
			day (int): Day
			hour (int): Hour
		
		Returns:
			Date: Date with specified time (minutes and seconds set to 0)
		"""
		date = system.date.getDate(year, month, day)
		return system.date.setTime(date, hour, 0, 0)
	
	# Extract date components
	year = system.date.getYear(value)
	month = system.date.getMonth(value)
	day = system.date.getDayOfMonth(value)
	hour = system.date.getHour24(value)
	dayOfWeek = system.date.getDayOfWeek(value)
	
	# Get user selections
	dropDownPeriod = self.getChild("root").getChild("Filters").getChild("FilterContainer").getChild("FilterPeriod").getChild("DropdownPeriod").props.value
	shift = self.custom.times.shift
	startTime = self.getChild("root").getChild("Filters").getChild("FilterContainer").getChild("FilterStartDate").getChild("DateTimeInputStartDate").props.value
	
	# Process selected period
	if dropDownPeriod != 7:  # Not custom option
		if dropDownPeriod == 4:  # Current Day
			newDate = setDateTime(year, month, day, 0)
			value = newDate
		
		elif dropDownPeriod == 3:  # Previous Day
			newDate = setDateTime(year, month, day - 1, 0)
			value = newDate
		
		elif dropDownPeriod == -1:  # No specific selection
			value = setDateTime(year, month, day, hour)
		
		elif dropDownPeriod == 6:  # Months
			value = setDateTime(year, month, 1, 0)
		
		elif dropDownPeriod == 5:  # Weeks
			# Calculate day of week (1: Sunday, 7: Saturday)
			dayOfWeek = system.date.getDayOfWeek(system.date.getDate(year, month, day))
			
			# Calculate previous Monday
			if dayOfWeek == 2:  # If it is Monday (Day 2)
				if hour >= 6:
					previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -dayOfWeek + 2)
				else:
					# Go back one week (7 days)
					previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -7)
			
			elif dayOfWeek > 2:
				previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -dayOfWeek + 2)
			
			else:
				previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -6)
			
			# Set time to 00:00:00
			value = setDateTime(
				system.date.getYear(previousMonday),
				system.date.getMonth(previousMonday),
				system.date.getDayOfMonth(previousMonday),
				0
			)
		
		# Shift logic
		if shift == 'Day':
			if dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Shift C
				value = setDateTime(year, month, day - 1, 18)
			
			elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Shift A
				value = setDateTime(year, month, day, 6)
		
		elif shift == 'Night':
			if dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Shift C
				value = setDateTime(year, month, day if hour >= 18 else day - 1, 6)
			
			elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Shift A
				value = setDateTime(year, month, day if hour >= 18 else day - 1, 18)
	
	else:
		# If dropdown period is 7 (custom), use start time
		value = startTime
	
	return value

"""
	Set date to yesterday at current time and refresh all event analysis bindings.
	
	This script is typically called from a button or component event to update
	the view with yesterday's data.
	"""
	
	# Get current datetime components
	now = system.date.now()
	year = system.date.getYear(now)
	month = system.date.getMonth(now)
	day = system.date.getDayOfMonth(now)
	hour = system.date.getHour24(now)
	minute = system.date.getMinute(now)
	
	# Set date to yesterday at current time
	date = system.date.getDate(year, month, day - 1)
	newDate = system.date.setTime(date, hour, minute, 0)
	
	# Update component value
	self.props.value = newDate
	
	# Refresh all event analysis bindings
	self.view.custom.refreshBindings = True
